authorization: User confirmed no human reviewers and explicitly authorized deterministic-primary / machine-secondary route.
scope: Evaluation only; collection engineering remains CLOSED.
supersedes: Human review prerequisite for this E4 evaluation route only; historical protocols retained.
primary_metric: Unit-aware deterministic final N4 delivered correctness on predeclared numeric-reference-eligible tasks only. Not whole-E4 semantic quality.
deterministic_eligibility: 17 tasks identified exclusively from existing task/reference route; 68 trajectories. Eligibility cannot depend on candidate outputs or model performance.
deterministic_readiness_gate: Freeze per-task unit/scale contracts and reference-independent final-answer extraction; synthetic tests before candidate output access. No scanning answers for a gold-matching number.
numeric_tolerance: Retain existing C9 absolute error <= max(1e-6,1e-4*abs(reference)) in reference units; percent/ratio conversion requires explicit task-unit contract, never blind factor-100 matching.
secondary_metric: Machine-judged final-answer quality on all applicable tasks after machine calibration and stability gates; median of three 0-4 scores divided by 4. Report independently from deterministic endpoint.
machine_gates: Existing Amendment-003 parse/agreement/duplicate/order-stability thresholds unchanged; no replacement by a two-family-only consensus.
missing_evaluator_labels: Missing, never zero; block corresponding analysis.
provider_failure: delivered quality zero; semantic correctness unavailable
workflow_validity: Must define mechanically from frozen interface contract before labels; do not tune against judged answer quality.
target: Final N4 delivered quality propagated as RTG, endpoint-specific.
learning_controls: Existing estimator, grouped folds, bootstrap, no post-result retuning and GO/STOP rules retained. Subset experiments labeled development only.
inference_scope: Numeric subset cannot establish whole-E4 effect; one-step OPE cannot establish full adaptive-workflow causal value.
holdout: No reserved holdout access in this amendment.

judge_format_repair.allowed: Only deterministic syntax normalization with exact label coverage and unchanged integer scores/reasons; raw response preserved.
